_comment: Goal -> route. A step is a skill or plugin in THIS repo (bare name), or `<plugin>@<source-id>` / `@<source-id>` for an outside source in sources.json. scripts/build-index.py fails if any step does not resolve. Add a route only when it has been walked and works; mark gaps nobody fills with `gap: true`.

routes.goal: Find a capability before building or installing one
routes.note: Inventory first; the lightest capability that works wins; adoption goes through nix-config.

routes.goal: Capture what a session figured out, so no session rediscovers it
routes.note: harvest triages and lands via PR; skill-creator tests; the gate validates before it ships.

routes.goal: Keep the skill library from only growing: find unused skills and retire them
routes.note: Ported from Hermes Agent's curator; retires from the harness via PR, never deletes.

routes.goal: Write up a discovery as one fact-checked document other agents can derive posts, articles and slides from
routes.note: Channel formatting is inherited: search the map and indexes for a repurposing skill.

routes.goal: Make a repo's default branch a safe, auto-merging release
routes.note: Required check first, App-token auto-merge second.

routes.goal: Turn a repo's review history into agent instructions
routes.note: Candidate; not declared in nix-config yet.

routes.goal: Work on a Nix flake repo with Claude Code
Author a userscript or diagnose a live web page
Operate a physical Android phone over ADB
Send a formatted message with attachments from a native macOS app
Answer questions from a local document corpus
Tailor a resume to a job posting
Supervise Claude Code hooks so one bad hook cannot wedge a session
Get scannable, verdict-first answers and architecture maps
General language- or domain-specific engineering agents
routes.note: Candidate; pick single plugins, not the whole collection.
